messages:
rachel: Observing a weird schema regression on the sparrow-int4 canary. Numeric fields coming back as strings or weird tokens ("NaN"/"Infinity") and some floats in scientific notation. Strict JSON schema rejects these as type errors.

priya: frequency? example payload?

rachel: ~0.7% of runs on structured-output. Snippet from post-merge buffer:

```
{
  "id": "run-982",
  "predictions": [
    {"label": "positive", "score": "0.874", "confidence": "9.2e-01"},
    {"label": "neutral", "score": "\"NaN\"", "confidence": "0.0"}
  ]
}
```

(schema expects score: number, confidence: number). Parser throws TypeError: expected number but got string/NaN.

ethan: NaN/Infinity in JSON are not valid JSON numbers. Where are they coming from? Model output literally contains the token sequence NaN?

rachel: yes looks like model sampled literal tokens like NaN or emitted numeric values with quotes. In int4 path we also see the tokenizer/serializer interplay producing quoted numerics when buffers circumvent the usual escape/emit path during retries. Example of scientific notation emitted as string: "9.2e-01".

tom: interesting edge-case: some serializer passes attempted to be conservative and quoted unknown token runs to avoid breaking JSON, turning numbers into strings. But if later we coerce partially or do double-escape, you end up with strings. Also model can output token sequence 'NaN' which is not a JSON number.

priya: repro steps? we need a deterministic harness.

rachel: repro: run canary with --quant=int4 --temp=0.9 --streaming=false --retry-prob=0.05 and use the numeric-output eval prompt in eng-ml/canary-repro/num-coerce-repro.sh. I can upload gist. Repro triggers NaN token ~1/1500, quoted nums ~1/140.

ethan: mitigation ideas: 1) sanitizer that coerces quoted numeric strings to numbers when safe (regex detection plus JSON parse), 2) reject literal NaN/Infinity tokens and replace with null or a special metadata field like "_num_parse_error":true, 3) patch serializer so that any buffer that hasn't passed through numeric-normalizer is routed through it before final emit, 4) add eval gating to block canary if structured_numeric_coercions > 0.

priya: prefer 1+3 short-term: coerce safe numeric strings (int, float, sci notation) to numbers before schema validation. For NaN/Infinity we should map to null and log sample, because downstream tools won't accept NaN. Also add a strict-canary flag that fails rollout on any coercions so we don't silently hide regressions.

tom: small note: coercing strings to numbers can mask model intent: sometimes model may legitimately want a string (e.g., zip codes). We should only coerce when schema expects number. So combine schema-aware coercion: look at route's JSON schema and only coerce fields typed number.

rachel: agreed. Implementation plan: a) add a schema-aware numeric_normalizer step in aggregator that walks the object, for fields typed number attempt JS-number coercion on strings matching ^-?\d+(\.\d+)?([eE][-+]?\d+)?$; if matches, convert to number. b) if value == 'NaN' or 'Infinity' (case-insensitive) replace with null and increment structured_numeric_special_token counter and attach sample to logs. c) ensure retry paths feed through same normalizer. d) increment telemetry structured_numeric_coercion{model,quant,route,canary}. e) add canary gate: if structured_numeric_coercion>0 then fail canary and alert.

ethan: I'll own the aggregator normalizer PR and add unit tests for edge cases (zip codes, large ints, sci notation, negative numbers).

priya: I'll add the canary gating and telemetry. Also add a linter in canary that simulates schema-aware coercion and reports difference so reviewers can see what was coerced.

opsbot: Created ticket INF-3525 assigned to ethan and priya. Linked to previous canary alerts. https://internal/ops/INF-3525 :white_check_mark:

tom: long-term we should surface model-side token constraints in our model-onboarding checklist: forbid emitting NaN/Infinity tokens for numeric fields or assign typed tokens. I'll add it to model-onboard RFC.

rachel: thanks. uploading repro script and samples to eng-ml/canary-repro/num-coerce-repro.sh now, will ping when done :mag:
